notes: Printer Bot 3.0.5 stops the hidden receipt browsers from causing failed Windows sign-ins, which could lock a local Windows account, and from signing in to your Microsoft account. It also gives a YouTube Super Chat the layout of a Twitch cheer: the picture, the amount, "Name sent a Super Chat!" and the date at the top, and only the viewer's message in the box. A YouTube receipt without a profile picture shows a grey placeholder. On a Letter printer set to Large message, only High Roller cheers, High Roller Super Chats and gift subs print large; everything else prints Scaled like 80 mm. On a narrow dock, the box of Printers per browser no longer sits under a large gap. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import. A Printer Bot older than 2.5.0 needs one first (see UPDATING.md on GitHub). After the update, restart Streamer.bot and reload the dock. The full list of changes is in the release notes of 3.0.5 on GitHub.
